body:
Found wiring up the notebook portal's SSO cookie login: GetAgentByID-based live recheck (added for the suspended-agent fix) only checks the agents table, so a human Google session's sub (a user ID) always missed and got incorrectly bounced to login on every request. Gated the recheck on absence of the 'email' claim (agent-issued tokens never carry it). New regression test TestRequireCookieAuth_HumanGoogleSessionNotTreatedAsAgent, verified red/green. Commit b1fd92f.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix: RequireCookieAuth live-status recheck must not treat human sessions as agents
